arxiv-1707-01093.title: Gaussian Bandwidth Selection for Manifold Learning and Classification
arxiv-1707-01093.creator: Ofir Lindenbaum, Moshe Salhov, Arie Yeredor, Amir Averbuch
arxiv-1707-01093.description: Abstract Kernel methods play a critical role in many machine learning algorithms. They are useful in manifold learning, classification, clustering and other data analysis tasks. Setting the kernel’s scale parameter, also referred to as the kernel’s bandwidth, highly affects the performance of the task in hand.

arxiv-2007-15784.title: New Results in Sona Drawing: Hardness and TSP Separation
arxiv-2007-15784.creator: Man-Kwun Chiu, Erik D. Demaine, Yevhenii Diomidov, David Eppstein, Robert A. Hearn, Adam Hesterberg, Matias Korman, Irene Parada, Mikhail Rudoy
arxiv-2007-15784.description: Abstract Given a set of point sites, a sona drawing is a single closed curve, disjoint from the sites and intersecting itself only in simple crossings, so that each bounded region of its complement contains exactly one of the sites.

arxiv-2305-02396.title: Can Feature Engineering Help Quantum Machine Learning for Malware Detection?
arxiv-2305-02396.creator: Ran Liu, Maksim Eren, Charles Nicholas
arxiv-2305-02396.description: Abstract With the increasing number and sophistication of malware attacks, malware detection systems based on machine learning (ML) grow in importance. At the same time, many popular ML models used in malware classification are supervised solutions. These supervised classifiers often do not generalize well to novel malware.

arxiv-2408-08037.title: Maximum entropy models for patterns of gene expression
arxiv-2408-08037.creator: Camilla Sarra, Leopoldo Sarra, Luca Di Carlo, Trevor GrandPre, Yaojun Zhang, Curtis G. Callan, Jr, William Bialek
arxiv-2408-08037.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Camilla Sarra, Leopoldo Sarra, Luca Di Carlo, Trevor GrandPre, Yaojun Zhang, Curtis G. Callan, Jr, William Bialek. New experimental methods make it possible to measure the expression levels of many genes, simultaneously, in snapshots from thousands or even millions of individual cells. Current approaches to analyze these experiments involve clustering or low-dimensional projections.

arxiv-2409-15405.title: Brown measures of deformed L ∞ L^{\infty} -valued circular elements
arxiv-2409-15405.creator: Johannes Alt, Torben Krüger
arxiv-2409-15405.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Johannes Alt, Torben Krüger. We consider the Brown measure of a + 𝔠 a+\mathfrak{c} , where a a lies in a commutative tracial von Neumann algebra ℬ \mathcal{B} and 𝔠 \mathfrak{c} is a ℬ \mathcal{B} -valued circular element. Under certain regularity conditions on a a and the covariance of 𝔠 \mathfrak{c} this Brown measure has a density with respect to the Lebesgue measure on the complex plane which is real analytic apart from jump discontinuities at the boundary of its support.

arxiv-2410-13500.title: SAda-Net: A Self-Supervised Adaptive Stereo Estimation CNN For Remote Sensing Image Data
arxiv-2410-13500.creator: Dominik Hirner, Friedrich Fraundorfer
arxiv-2410-13500.description: Abstract Stereo estimation has made many advancements in recent years with the introduction of deep-learning. However the traditional supervised approach to deep-learning requires the creation of accurate and plentiful ground-truth data, which is expensive to create and not available in many situations.

arxiv-2411-03504.title: Exact Designs for Order-of-Addition Experiments Under a Transition-Effect Model
arxiv-2411-03504.creator: Jiayi Zheng, Nicholas Rios
arxiv-2411-03504.description: Abstract In the chemical, pharmaceutical, and food industries, sometimes the order of adding a set of components has an impact on the final product. These are instances of the order-of-addition (OofA) problem, which aims to find the optimal sequence of the components.

pmc-13574676.title: Psychometric validation of the Romanian Scenario-Based Dieting Self-Efficacy Scale in adults with overweight and obesity
pmc-13574676.creator: Diana Draia, Salomeia Putnoky, Ioana Cristina Olariu, Costela Lacrimioara Serban
pmc-13574676.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionOverweight and obesity require sustained changes in eating behaviour, yet long-term adherence to dietary recommendations remains difficult. Dieting self-efficacy, defined as confidence in managing eating-related challenges, is an important self-regulatory construct in weight management. This study aimed to translate and evaluate the psychometric properties of the Romanian version of the Scenario-Based Dieting Self-Efficacy Scale (DIET-SE) in adults with overweight and obesity.MethodsA total of 509 adults from the general Romanian population completed an online survey between February and April 2026.
